fields.headline: THE NINE-HOLE DAY.
fields.body: Not every society day is 18 holes, and not every Cup needs to be.

fields.headline:
HALF THE HOLES.
ALL THE SCORING.
fields.body: A nine-hole session is scored exactly like an eighteen. Same formats, same points, same result at the end.

fields.headline: NINE-HOLE SHOTS.
fields.body: A nine-hole session gets a nine-hole course handicap, off the nine you are playing, then the format's allowance on top.

fields.headline: ONE SETTING.
fields.body: Hole count sits on the session with the format and the allowances, so one Cup can hold a nine-hole session and an eighteen-hole one.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
